name: AR-Noise Coarse-to-Fine MPPI
tagline: Multi-restart MPPI with AR(1) temporally smooth noise, downsampled-then-full-T action grids, exploration injection, and warm starts.
init_recovers: MPPI when n_restarts=1, explore_frac=0, ar_coeff=0, single resolution.
diff_from_baseline: Adds three orthogonal pieces on top of MPPI: AR(1) temporally correlated noise (vs. white Gaussian), a coarse→fine 2-stage resolution schedule with linear interpolation, and 4 directionally diverse restarts with warm-start carry-over — none of CEM/MPPI/iCEM combine restarts with downsampled-then-full action grids.

name: Gradient-Augmented MPPI
tagline: MPPI with one Adam-free gradient step on each sample using JEPA's differentiable rollout, then exponentially weighted update.
diff_from_baseline: Adds an explicit gradient step through the JEPA world model on every sampled trajectory before the standard MPPI exponential-weight update — none of the named baselines backpropagate through the unroll.

name: Frontier Beam with Progress Shaping
tagline: Receding-horizon beam search over short-prefix latent rollouts, scored by terminal+discounted+progress objective with a diversity penalty.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces flat CEM/MPPI/iCEM resampling with a staged beam search that grows action prefixes one segment of 5 at a time using a shaped objective (terminal + discounted + progress + diversity) over per-step JEPA latent costs — none of the baselines reuse per-step latent costs or use beam expansion.

name: Diverse-Init Gradient + CEM Refine
tagline: Two-phase planner: SGD+momentum on diverse structured initial trajectories through the JEPA model, then CEM around the best.
diff_from_baseline: Combines first-order optimisation (SGD+momentum through the JEPA unroll on structured initial trajectories) with a CEM-style refinement around the best gradient solution — CEM/MPPI/iCEM are sampling-only with no gradients and no structured init templates.

name: Adaptive Basis CEM (AB-CEM)
tagline: Run CEM in a low-dimensional Fourier+polynomial basis over actions with warm-started coefficients and elite-variance σ adaptation.

key_hyperparams.name: num_basis
key_hyperparams.role: Fourier+poly basis dim per action coord

init_recovers: Plain CEM in time domain when Φ = I (basis=identity).
diff_from_baseline: CEM is moved from the per-step action space ℝᵀ into a 5-dim Fourier+polynomial coefficient space (Φ-projection enforces smooth trajectories), with warm-started coefficients via Φ⁺·shift and an elite-variance-driven σ rescaling — none of CEM/MPPI/iCEM optimise in a basis or vary σ from elite cost variance.
